description: `@o = { ...@o, inner: { ys: @o.inner.ys } }` keeps the append-only tape: accepted by the analyzer AND Core, and runs.
rationale: The override's `@o.inner.ys` reads the spread's snapshot; Core reads a snapshot Local as the place it snapshots, so it no longer refuses with a raw C3 a program the analyzer accepted (review F3).
